name: Sika Tite BE
paste:
SIKA® TITE BE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Tite BE, April 2023, Version 01.07 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sika_tite_be.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Tite BE where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Tite BE is a heavy duty, highly flexible, water based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Sika® Tite BE is suitable for permanent immersion and provides excellent adhesion to a wide range of substrates.Sika® Tite BE is fast drying, easy to apply and is designed for non-UV exposed applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Retaining walls
    - Planter boxes
    - Foundations and basement walls
    - Damp proof sandwich membrane
    - Ponds and water features
    - Repairs on existing bitumen surfaces and membranes (Non-UV exposed)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Tite BE
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Heavy duty, highly flexible, water based bitumen waterproofing membrane
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. AS/NZS 4020 : 2018 Products for use in contact with drinking water
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/NZS 4020 : 2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fast drying
    - Highly flexible- Class III membrane
    - One part – No mixing
    - Non flammable, Non hazardous
    - Water based
    - Suitable for permanent immersion
    - Excellent adhesion to most substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Water based bitumen
    - Colour: Black
    - Density: 1.2kg/L
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 4 Litre & 15 Litre plastic pails
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacture in original, sealed containers, if the storage conditions are met.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry, weatherproof environment, protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. The substrate surface must be continuous, all projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. Sika® Tite BE can be mixed with sand and cement or pre-bagged mortar mix to form a screed to falls or patching render with improved adhesion and tensile properties.
    - Sheeting
    - Fibrous cement sheeting must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation directions. Concrete
    - Concrete must be allowed to cure for 28 days and cement render and sand and cement screeds must be allowed to cure for 7 days prior to the application. Surfaces must be even and smooth, imperfections repaired with a suitable Sika® MonoTop repair mortar. Priming
    - Dry porous substrates must be primed using a dilute 1 part Sika® Tite BE to 3 parts water, work well into the substrate to ensure adequate penetration, avoid ponding. Allow to dry prior to general application. If moisture is present, allow for application of Sikalastic Moisture Seal, refer to PDS for application rates.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.07) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Dry film thickness: Minimum 1mm DFT (Dry film thickness) required; 2x coats of 1 Litre per m2 are required to achieve a 1mm DFT
    - Consumption: 1.0mm DFT- (Dry Film thickness): 7.5m2 per 15L pail; 2m2 per 4L pail
    - Substrates: Sika® Tite BE can be applied to the following substrates: Concrete; Masonry; Sand/cement screeds; Fibrous cement sheeting; Compressed fibrous cement sheeting; Steel/Aluminium; Timber posts
    - Curing time: Sika® Tite BE must be cured for at least 48 hours at 23°C (longer at lower temperatures.); Sika® Tite BE must be cured for a minimum 3 days before coming in contact with water or any form of backfill.
    - Drying time: Allow minimum 2 - 4 hours between coats at 23°C. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions. Drying time is dependent on ambient temperature and relative humidity.
4.3 Mixing. Single component, ready to use undiluted, prior to application thoroughly mix using a mechanical mixer to produce a homogenous liquid.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with water while the material is still wet. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - Sika® Tite BE is not designed to stop a hydrostatic head of water pressure.
    - Sika® Tite BE must not be used over damp, wet or contaminated substrates.
    - Sika® Tite BE must not be applied if it is raining or if rain is imminent.
    - Sika® Tite BE must not be applied directly over protective coatings.
    - Sika® Tite BE must not be used as a trafficable, exposed or UV stable coating.
    - Sika® Tite BE is not compatible with polyurethane or silicone sealants.
    - In backfilling applications (planter boxes/retaining walls etc) allow a minimum of 3 days cure and use suitable protection layer prior to backfilling.
    - In potable water applications a minimum of 3 cycles of fill and flush is recommended after of minimum 3 days cure.
    - Do not apply where the substrate temperature is below 10°C or greater than 35°C.
    - Contact Sika Technical Service for advice if further information is required.
4.6 Further information. ▪ Safety Data Sheet (SDS)

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate temperature. +10 to +35 C
5.3 Substrate moisture content. Up to 5%
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - Sika® Tite BE must not be applied if it is raining or if rain is imminent.
    - Do not apply where the substrate temperature is below 10°C or greater than 35°C.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Tite BE, April 2023, Version 01.07, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sika_tite_be.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Tite BE, version 07/10/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sds-sikatite-be.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
